VIBEFALL
Deep Cavern Expedition
Five levels of cavern lie beneath the moonlit jungle. Somewhere down there are 8 gold bars, the Diamond Ring, and your cat Quickclaw. Grab everything, then climb back to the cave mouth on the far left of the surface before the lantern burns out. Bats, scorpions, frogs and eels don't kill you — they bounce you back to the last green cross and cost you points.
←→ run   ↑↓ climb / drop   Space jump & swim   P pause   R restart
About Vibefall

What this is

A modern tribute to Pitfall II: Lost Caverns — a multi-level side-scrolling cavern crawl with checkpoint crosses instead of lives. Everything (art, sound, world) is generated at runtime: no images, no audio files, no network.

Design notes & assumptions

  • The cavern is procedurally built from a fixed seed, so the map is the same every run — you can learn it.
  • Five bands: moonlit jungle surface plus four cavern levels. Falling is never fatal.
  • Hazard contact = teleport to your last green cross, −300 points, brief invulnerability.
  • Losing is the lantern timer running out (10:00). There is no life counter, as in the original.
  • Balloons are moving lifts — ride them up shafts you can't jump.
  • Scoring: gold bar 5,000 · diamond ring 10,000 · Quickclaw 20,000 · new cross 500 · escape bonus 50 × seconds left.
  • Audio uses the Web Audio API and starts on your first click, per browser autoplay rules.

Controls

Arrows or WASD to move, Space/Up to jump, Down to drop through a ladder top, P or Esc to pause, R to restart. On touch devices an on-screen pad appears automatically.
